Product Analyst - Swiggy, Bengaluru
Full-time | Mid-level

Swiggy is India's leading on-demand convenience platform. The Growth Analytics team is hiring a
Product Analyst to turn product data into decisions for our consumer app.

What you'll do
- Define and track product metrics and KPIs for the consumer ordering funnel
- Design, run and analyse A/B tests with product managers and engineers
- Build self-serve dashboards in Tableau or Power BI for product and business teams
- Write complex SQL queries on large datasets to answer product questions
- Find growth opportunities through funnel, cohort and retention analysis
- Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders

What we're looking for
- 2-4 years of experience in product or business analytics
- Strong SQL and Excel skills; Python (pandas) for analysis
- Hands-on experience with A/B testing and basic statistics
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Economics or a related field

Nice to have
- Experience with Amplitude or Mixpanel
- Familiarity with BigQuery or Snowflake
- Experience in e-commerce or food-tech
